name: Chana Masala
description: Comforting chickpeas simmered in a tangy tomato-onion masala with ginger, green chilies and warm Pakistani spices.
method: Heat oil and fry cumin seeds and onions until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, green chilies and powdered spices.
Cook until the tomatoes break down and oil begins to separate.
Add chickpeas with a little cooking water and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Lightly mash a few chickpeas to thicken the gravy.
Finish with garam masala and fresh coriander and serve with roti, naan or rice.
